summary: This medicine can cause severe allergic reactions, such as itchy hives (urticaria) and deeper skin swelling (angioedema), which require stopping the treatment [3]. It also carries a warning that it may harm an unborn baby if taken during pregnancy [3]. Additionally, based on a small computer model rather than tests in people, the drug received a low risk score for the liver and a medium risk score for the heart [M].
